reviews.comment:
Un solo playero y se toma todo el tiempo para atender, entre auto y auto se va adentro de la cabina y hay que esperarlo. Término de  armar en mi vehículo y lo tuve que estar esperando para pagarle. Un desastre.

(Translated by Google)
There was only one attendant, and he took forever to help. Between cars, he went inside the booth, and we had to wait for him. I finished setting up my car, and then I had to wait to pay him. A disaster.
